rationale: The target contributes concrete probe results and behavioral observations about YAML/TOML/JSON conversion flags, so its main function is delivering results. It also reports observed edge cases and outputs, fitting evidence_observation as secondary.

evidence.text: More probes: YAML parse: yes stays string, null/~ -> null, dates -> ISO `2020-01-01T00:00:00Z`, `.inf` -> Infinity by default; -n turns Infinity numeric max float (NaN remains string).
TOML omits null keys. JSON flags: -jji pretty 2-space; -jje escapes < > & as \\u003c etc. YAML->TOML nested map becomes blank line + [section].
`-k` can error on keys like true/null (reflect Set zero value), while default keys quoted when needed.
